reason: The plugin is primarily a user-facing navigation/inspection panel for the DSH Web GUI: it surfaces MCP server and tool inventory, shows transport/state metadata, and displays tool schemas plus recent usage based on local session logs, with filtering and export utilities. Evidence supports UI presentation and local inventory/inspection behavior via a host API and client plugin slots, rather than altering core execution or creating new external integrations.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DSH Web GUI 提供“ MCP Tools ”侧边栏面板，用于集中查看会话可见的 MCP 服务器和工具、其参数 schema、最近使用信息，并支持检索与导出。
summaries.en: This plugin adds an MCP Tools panel to the DSH web GUI to show session-visible MCP servers and tools, including schemas and recent usage, with search, health checks, and export features.

capabilities: Reads local session log files under the DSH session directory to compute last-used tool data
Calls configured MCP streamable-http endpoints for health checks (HEAD requests)
Provides a local GET API route that returns MCP inventory and usage metadata
Renders a floating sidebar/overlay panel and supports search/filter over tool and server metadata
Allows exporting inventory data as JSON or Markdown

reasons.code: README.md states this is a DSH Web GUI MCP Tools panel with sidebar/overlay presentation, live search, usage view, and favorites.
README.md Architecture section describes a host endpoint GET /api/mcp-view/tools sourced from Cordis tool/runtime data and session logs.
README.md and package manifest indicate a web profile plugin with dsh bundle patching and a dedicated client entry, confirming host+browser integration.
Repository tree includes host output (lib/index.js), client bundle (lib/client.js), and source (src/index.ts) matching a hot-pluggable web plugin.
